author: Unity
description:
In this video from the Unity Programmatic content studio, we breakdown who's actually playing mobile games today, and why the old assumptions about gaming audiences no longer hold up. 

Discover how brands and agencies can rethink their media plans now that mobile gaming reaches one of the broadest, most diverse audiences in digital media in this conversation with Index Exchange's Alex Gardner, Nexxen's Chance Johnson, Pinterest's Heather Carver, Zynga's Gabrielle Heyman, WPP's Lauren Wetzel, and Mintegral's Phoena Pang.

Unity Programmatic Solutions enables  performance and brand marketers to access exclusive and quality mobile supply with ad formats and experiences for gaming and app demand.

🔗 Learn more about reaching mobile gaming audiences with Unity: https://unity.com/products/programmatic-solutions
